quote.text: No one will bring back the years; no one will restore you to yourself. Life will follow the path it began to take, and will neither reverse nor check its course. It will cause no commotion to remind you of its swiftness, but glide on quietly. It will not lengthen itself for a king’s command or a people’s favour. As it started out on its first day, so it will run on, nowhere pausing or turning aside. What will be the outcome? You have been preoccupied while life hastens on. Meanwhile death will arrive, and you have no choice in making yourself available for that.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that time with your children is irreplaceable; every moment is precious, and just as life moves inexorably forward, so does the fleeting nature of growing up—embrace every lesson and cherish each memory.
    • Commit to being fully present with your children, understanding that distractions may steal away these transient moments, and that nurturing their character is a lifelong investment, much like the steady course of life itself.
  • Leadership
    • Lead with the wisdom that time, once spent, cannot be reclaimed; let this truth guide your decisions, instilling a sense of urgency to act with purpose and clarity in every action you take.
    • Embrace the balance of patience and action, knowing that while life always progresses without pause, effective leadership harnesses the present, focusing on what truly matters for the collective good.
  • Product Management
    • Understand that project timelines, much like life, continue relentlessly; prioritize features and improvements with the knowledge that delaying or dwelling on the past can undermine future progress.
    • Harness the swift passage of time by being proactive, agile, and adaptive—constantly re-align your strategy to meet evolving needs, ensuring that every decision propels your product forward, mindful that waiting might mean losing the moment.
